img_229.description: Central disc ringed by script, outer band with tub-like tiers and green patches. Two scaly fish drawn one above the other, facing opposite ways, joined by a long looping line; a blue wavy line beneath; two eight-pointed stars, one top-left and one bottom.
img_229.central_figure: Two fish tied together by a line, swimming in opposite directions
img_229.sign_reason: Two fish linked by a cord, facing opposite ways: the standard Pisces image.

img_505.description: Central circle with a ring of writing, surrounded by many outlined nude female figures with stars. In the centre a green-washed four-legged animal with a pointed snout, pointed ears and a tail curled up into a large loop over its back; a big eight-pointed star above it.
img_505.central_figure: A green, lizard- or dog-like four-legged creature with an upturned looped tail
img_505.sign_reason: Not fish, crab, lion, horned beast or human; the green reptile-like body with a raised curled tail suggests a stinging creature (scorpion drawn as a lizard/salamander). No claws visible, so not certain.

img_853.description: Inner circle with green-wash ground and blue water line; outer ring shows women in striped tubs/barrels with stars. Central animal is a long-bodied goat-like beast with swept-back curved horns and a beard, reaching up to eat from a dark green bush/tree.
img_853.central_figure: A bearded, horned goat-like animal browsing on a green bush
img_853.sign_reason: Horned, bearded small ruminant standing on land; no fish tail, so not a classical Capricorn sea-goat. A horned sheep/goat eating from a bush fits Aries; could be read as Capricorn by its goat look.

img_106.description: Uncoloured outline animal in a central circle with green ground; outer figures in coloured (red, blue, green) tubs. The animal has heavy horns curled forward and around, a long neck, and nibbles a green sprig.
img_106.central_figure: A pale outline ram/goat with curled horns eating a green plant
img_106.sign_reason: Thick horns curling round like a ram's, sheep/goat body, no fish tail.

img_558.description: Central circle with a ring of writing, surrounded by nude female figures. The centre shows a balance: an upright post with a crossbar and two pans hanging on cords, with blue touches.
img_558.sign_reason: Balance with two pans is the Libra emblem.

img_602.description: Central circle with a ring of writing, nude figures around. Inside, a single figure with a blue cap and long blue-striped robe spreading like a fan, holding out a hand, with an eight-pointed star to the left and a small flower at the foot.
img_602.central_figure: A robed person (likely a woman) holding something, with a star and a flower
img_602.sign_reason: A single robed, apparently female figure with a flower; no weapon, scales, pair or animal. Virgo is the sign shown as a lone maiden; gender not fully certain.

img_421.description: Central circle with a ring of writing; outer figures in tubs/barrels, one hole in the vellum on the left. Central animal painted solid red, long upright horns, cow-like body and tail, eating green fodder from a wicker basket, standing on a green ground line.
img_421.central_figure: A red horned cattle-like animal feeding from a basket
img_421.sign_reason: Large-bodied, cattle-like animal with long upright horns, coloured red: reads as a bull or cow rather than a sheep; horns are not ram-curled.

img_253.description: Central circle with a ring of writing, nude figures with stars around. Inside, two clothed people face each other holding hands: a man in green tunic and green hat, a woman in long blue gown with long hair.
img_253.central_figure: A man and a woman holding hands
img_253.sign_reason: A pair of people together; Gemini (the twins/lovers) is the paired-human sign. Shown here as a couple rather than identical twins.

img_649.description: Faint central circle with ring of writing on stained vellum. Central animal is a large four-legged beast with a thick curly mane and paws, open mouth showing tongue/teeth, light blue speckles and a red spot on its flank; a plant sprig behind.
img_649.sign_reason: Mane, large paws and big-cat body indicate a lion.

img_514.description: Central circle with ring of writing, nude figures around. Inside, a standing person in a broad hat and blue tunic holding a crossbow pointing down-left.
img_514.sign_reason: The figure carries a bow (crossbow): the archer sign, though shown as a man rather than a centaur.

img_320.description: Small central circle with ring of writing, many nude figures with stars around. Inside are two crustaceans one above the other, the upper pale green with red claws, the lower red, each with many legs and pincers.
img_320.sign_reason: Crustaceans with pincers and many legs: the crab sign.

img_579.description: Central circle with ring of writing; outer figures in red-washed robes and a tower-like structure. Central animal washed pink-red, with long curving horns, eating dark green leaves from a wicker basket on a green ground line.
img_579.central_figure: A pinkish horned cattle- or goat-like animal eating from a basket
img_579.sign_reason: Long horns and fairly heavy body like the red animal in img_421 (same basket motif), reads as a bull; horns could also suggest a goat, so Aries is the alternative.

recognise_source: Yes. After looking at all twelve: the script, nude figures in tubs and rings of stars match the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408, about folios 70v-73v). That cycle has no Capricorn or Aquarius and two pages each for Aries and Taurus. I did not use this knowledge to choose the signs, but it agrees with them.
